detailed_descriptions_html.en:
NEW CITY, EMPTY POCKETS

You skipped town in a hurry, and this city doesn’t care who you used to be. An old friend covers a motel room and points you at the docks. The rest is on you.

YOUR FIRST HUSTLE

The port is full of cheap imported goods and people too lazy to drive down and get them. So you do. Pack a van, mark it up, deliver it. Congratulations, you’re an entrepreneur.

STOP DOING IT YOURSELF

Moving every box by hand has a ceiling, and it’s low. Hire employees, put a fleet on the road, run your office and scale your operation.

FROM THE DOCKS TO THE PENTHOUSE

Collect cars, repaint them on a whim, and furnish a place with a view of the whole city. You started in a motel room, moving boxes by hand. Now someone else does that.
